name: Feed My Startup

sources.title: Submit Your Startup — form or 700-word unique article by email
Write for Us — guest article guidelines

requirements: Startup/entrepreneurship content for a small WordPress blog audience
Two free routes: fill the submit-startup form, or email a 700-word unique article covering the startup with two images to contact@feedmystartup.com
Guest articles must be 700+ words, unique, include relevant images, and must not link to promotional websites (promotional articles are rejected)
Guest-post route requires registering a profile via wp-login.php
preparation: Startup details for the form, or a finished 700+ word unique article with two images
For articles: a registered account via https://feedmystartup.com//wp-login.php
workflow: Startup showcase: open https://feedmystartup.com/submit-your-startup/ and fill the form, or email the 700-word article + two images
Guest post: register at wp-login, create a profile, submit the article for review
Wait for editorial review — no stated turnaround
watchFor: Promotional links inside articles get the piece rejected — keep the body editorial
The site is a small, lightly maintained WordPress blog (© 2021 footer); set low traffic expectations
The submit form's fields did not render in a text fetch — the email route is a reliable fallback
countsAsLive: A post about the startup/app is published on feedmystartup.com under Startups or Technology
unknowns: Exact fields on the submit-startup form
Whether published posts carry dofollow links
